subject: general
question: The largest peninsular river in India is:
solution:
The correct answer is "__**Godavari**__".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• It is the **second-longest stretch** of brownish water in India.
 
• It is a seasonal river, and in the summer, when it monsoons, it typically dries out and widens.
 
• This river is the largest peninsular river system in India.
 
• It is also called Dakshin Ganga.
 
• It originated from Tryambak hill in the Western Ghats.
 
• It originates from the Nashik district in Maharashtra.
 
• Its length is usually 1465 km.
 
• The main tributaries of Godavari are Pranahita, Indravati and Manjira.
 
• On the Godavari River, between **Kovvur and Rajahmundry**, is the largest railroad bridge in **Asia**.
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is "**Godavari**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Along these river's banks, there are a lot of pilgrimage sites, including **Nasik, Bhadrachalam, and Trimbak**.
 
• The river flows through the states of **Madhya Pradesh, Telangana, Andhra Pradesh, and Orissa** in a southeasterly direction before emptying into the Bay of Bengal.
 
• By the river, Rajahmundry develops a **lush delta**.
